note: T12 引擎选择模型参数。每个数带 source + confidence。confidence: high/medium/low/none。找不到写 null，不编。键名全 ASCII（D-05）。

commuter.source: ABS Census 2016 via Huda et al. 2025 (ScienceDirect): 436,752 people commute to work in Melbourne CBD, 27% by car; plus City of Melbourne Transport Strategy 2030 work-trip focus. Remainder of car-trip mix split by CBD function (work vs retail/services) with VISTA trip-purpose categories.
commuter.note: 没有「CBD 车行出行目的四分」的直接公开表。0.50 是通勤占车行主体的工作假设：CBD 白天车流以通勤为主，ABS 显示 CBD 岗位高度集中；区间放宽到 0.40-0.60。

local.source: VISTA trip purpose categories (Buy Something / Pick-up or Deliver / Education / social); City of Melbourne Transport Strategy 2030 (local access).
local.note: 本地办事/购物/接送。VISTA 有 trip purpose 分类但没有「目的地=LGA 且用车」的四类拆分公开汇总；0.25 为零售与服务型出行的常见量级。

tourist.source: City of Melbourne / Tourism Victoria CBD visitor economy reports (qualitative); VISTA social & recreation trip share.
tourist.note: 游客/休闲。CBD 有大量国际与州际访客，但多数步行/电车；车行游客占比偏低。0.10 是保守工作假设。

delivery.source: ABS Survey of Motor Vehicle Use (freight fleet: 84.5% light commercial); O'Fallon & Sullivan light/medium commercial vehicle use in urban centres; Infrastructure Australia Urban Transport Crowding and Congestion (service vehicles).
delivery.note: 送货/商用车。ABS 车队构成是全国的，不是 CBD 车流份额；城配+服务车在 CBD 白天车流里常见 10-20% 量级。0.15 取中。

mix_sum_check.note: 四类占比之和必须为 1（test.sh 强制）

generic_warning_divert.source: Working assumption. Literature: Bonsall 1999 (TRID) early VMS surveys diversion 10-80%; Wardman 1996 (White Rose) 5-80%. Named-route messages divert more than generic warnings (Erke 2007 field trial used named alternative).
generic_warning_divert.note: 只写「前方施工」、不给推荐路线时的绕行比例。没有单独的「纯警告」实测；0.03 来自 lead 的两点校准假设（D-0929-1435）。区间宽，待实测。

named_route_divert.source: Erke, Sagberg & Hagman 2007, Effects of route guidance variable message signs (VMS) on driver behaviour, Transportation Research Part F. Field trial, motorway road closure + recommended alternative: about every fifth vehicle changed route (~20%). ScienceDirect: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1369847806000909
named_route_divert.note: 原文摘要：“About every fifth vehicle changed route choice according to the recommendation, and almost none drove as far as the closed road section.” 推荐绕行路约比主路长 70%。二手转述核对到原文。

stated_to_actual.source: Chatterjee 2002, Driver response to variable message sign information in London, Transportation Research Part A. Questionnaire stated intention vs observed diversion: only one-fifth of expected drivers actually diverted. ePrints Soton / ScienceDirect: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0965856401000173
stated_to_actual.note: 原文：“Only one-fifth of the number of drivers diverted compared to that expected from the results of the stated intention questionnaire.” 用途：问卷/大模型表态 → 实际行为的折扣系数（D-0929-1435 校准用）。

hurry.note: 赶不赶时间（引擎：乘在每分钟效用上，均值≈1，0.05–5）。无按四类人的公开数；delivery/commuter 可能更高但未核实。

familiar.source: Qualitative: commuters use habitual routes (route choice literature); Erke 2007 note that non-diverters knew local network.
familiar.note: 熟悉替代路线的比例（P1）。通勤者日常固定路线，熟悉度高。工作假设。

sign_trust.note: 没找到按通勤/本地/游客/送货四分的 VMS 信任率公开数据。Ermagun 2021 (ScienceDirect)：信任越高遵从越高，且 trip purpose 影响响应，但无干净比例。

queue_averse.note: 怕不怕堵（引擎：乘在排队上，0–5）。P2 风险偏好未找可引用数值。

truck_only.note: 只能走货车路（布尔）。delivery 在部分货车禁行道上应为 true，但是否按人设拆未定；交给引擎/方案侧。

familiar.note: 职业司机路熟，但赶时间窗口。

legibility_index_m_per_mm.source: NSW TSI-SP-008 Variable Message Signs (standards.transport.nsw.gov.au): legibility distance taken as 700 × letter height (cap height, same units → 25 m per 25 mm). US MUTCD / Access Board: ~35-40 ft per inch letter height (~10.7-12.2 m per 25 mm) is more conservative; AS 4852.1/4852.2 cover VMS design.
legibility_index_m_per_mm.note: 可读距离 ≈ 25 m × (字高 mm)。日间常用；夜间/恶劣天气要降。25 mm 字 → 约 625 m 理论可读（实际更短）。

reading_rate_wps.source: Human factors / VMS message design practice (Austroads Guide to Traffic Management Part 10; NJDOT VMS Operations Manual Dudek 2001). No single Australian mandated wps; 2-3 wps common planning value.
reading_rate_wps.note: 读完一句屏上文案的速度。引擎用「可读距离 ÷ 车速 = 秒」再对照这句话能不能读完。

max_frames.source: Austroads GTM Part 10 / AS 4852 message design: short messages, few phases preferred.
max_frames.note: VMS 轮播页数上限（P1 辅助）。

private_car_occupant_aud_ph.source: ATAP Parameter Values / Travel Time (atap.gov.au): private car travel $14.99 per person-hour (40% of Average Weekly Earnings). Cited in ATAP research report and BITRE (2025) which uses $35.59/h for some commuter cases — different basis (vehicle vs person, survey year).
private_car_occupant_aud_ph.note: P1。私家车乘客人·小时。车辆小时 = 人均 × 载客。

business_car_occupant_aud_ph.source: ATAP Travel Time: business car travel $48.63 per person-hour (129.8% of AWE).

commercial_occupant_aud_ph.source: ATAP Travel Time: commercial vehicle occupants $25.41 (courier/utility) to $28.45 (A-triple/double B-double) per person-hour.
commercial_occupant_aud_ph.note: P1。商用车乘员取区间中值。货车本身的时间价值另有 freight 项。

car_occupancy.source: City of Melbourne VISTA report (AWS PDF): “Car occupancy remains low, with just 1.09 persons per vehicle.” Cross-check: We Ride Australia submission cites 1.1 average occupancy.
car_occupancy.note: P1。墨尔本小汽车平均载客 1.09。

private_vehicle_hour_aud.note: P1 派生量。引擎若要按车辆延误计价用这个。

queue_aversion.note: P2。怕不怕堵 / 对排队不确定性的风险偏好，未找可引用数值。Song et al. 2025 指出 LLM 比真人更怕风险，但不是行为参数本身。

time_of_day_mix.note: P2。占比按时段变化。VISTA 有 day/hour 但未做成四类人时段矩阵；需要再拆。
